title: BLIT386 docs sitemap
description: Drives the public docs mirror generated by blit386-dev-fumapress/scripts/sync-docs-from-engine.mjs. This file is the single source of truth for which engine docs publish, their site URL, sidebar order, and subtitle. Editing doc prose never requires touching this file or the sync script; add, reorder, or re-describe entries here instead.

sections.description: Map of section id (the first path segment) to its sidebar title. Acronym casing (for example 'api' -> 'API') is why titles are explicit rather than derived.

pages.description: Published pages in sidebar order. Array order is the sidebar order; only listed docs publish (omitted docs stay link-only on GitHub).

src.description: Engine doc filename relative to docs/ (for example 'api-core.md').

path.description: Published site path as '<section>/<topic>' (no leading /docs/). The section must exist in 'sections'.

description.description: Page subtitle (frontmatter 'description'). The page title comes from the source H1, not from here.
